task.description: Produce the fix design for ISS-0106 / GitHub #364 per ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis in docs/issues/ISS-0106.json (root_cause, chosen_resolution, files_to_change fields). Root cause: tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig (TC-ISS503-01/02/03) opens its own raw pg.Conn, bypassing helpers.zig bpm_test_migrations_public advisory lock entirely, and holds AccessExclusiveLock on shared public-schema tables for the duration of an uncommitted transaction running GBL-084 DDL before rolling back. build.zig test-integration step (~line 1243) registers ~20 test binaries as unserialized concurrent dependencies, so this long lock-hold window collides with other binaries (including db_integration_test.zig), causing deadlocks (40P01) that abort db_integration_test.zig TC-DB-01-01/02 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_migrations, silently returning 0. Chosen resolution: (b) serialize test_iss503_rls_removal.zig out of the concurrent test-integration group in build.zig so it runs alone, not concurrently with other DDL-heavy binaries; optionally also wrap its raw-connection schema_migrations-adjacent operations with the existing bpm_test_migrations_public advisory lock pattern from helpers.zig as defense-in-depth.
acceptance_criteria: Design produces a Type E prose design at src/design/fix-ISS-0106.md
Design addresses the root_cause: DDL-heavy test_iss503_rls_removal.zig must not run concurrently with other test-integration binaries that touch public-schema tables

Design specifies exactly how build.zig test-integration step is restructured (e.g. dependency ordering / serial step) so that test_iss503_rls_removal.zig runs to completion before or after the rest of the concurrent group, without breaking other binaries or CI invocation of `zig build test-integration`
Design documents whether advisory-lock hardening inside test_iss503_rls_removal.zig is included and why
No implementation code (no function bodies, no actual build.zig diff) -- describe the change structurally
Fix scope <= 5 files, matching files_to_change in ISS-0106.json (build.zig, tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig)

result.summary: Type E design at src/design/fix-ISS-0106.md restructures build.zig's test-integration umbrella step so test_iss503_rls_removal.zig's run step depends on a new intermediate barrier step that aggregates every other test-integration binary's Run step, then re-attaches ISS-503 to the umbrella step -- forcing the build graph to run ISS-503 only after all other DDL/migration-touching binaries have completed, removing the AccessExclusiveLock concurrency window that causes the 40P01 deadlocks. Advisory-lock hardening in test_iss503_rls_removal.zig was evaluated and explicitly deferred as redundant given the structural fix; only a doc comment is added to that file cross-referencing the new barrier step. No error-set changes; no CI workflow files exist to audit for timeout impact.
